notes: Production trust store for ai-usage release candidates. It is intentionally empty: no production manifest key (ai-usage-release-2026-10) has been minted. The key's private half will live only in the release-signing authority domain (BWS project ai-usage-release-signing, GitHub Environment release-signing), and its PUBLIC half is added here in a reviewed change. Secret-free validation mints an ephemeral key and a temporary trust store instead (make release-validate-ephemeral).
